risks.risk: Projector may not be functional or may have internal damage (e.g., lamp failure, lens issues, or software problems).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the projector powered on, projecting an image, and cycling through inputs.

risks.risk: The lamp may be near end-of-life or already failed, reducing brightness and image quality.
risks.proof: A close-up of the lamp status indicator or a video showing the lamp light and projection brightness.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having reduced lamp life

risks.risk: The included cables may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., frayed wires, loose connectors).
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the cable connectors and ends, showing no damage or wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cables may be faulty

proof_requests: Video of the projector turned on and projecting an image.
Close-up of the lamp status indicator or lamp hours if available.
Close-up of the cable connectors to verify they are intact.
Photo of the front lens to check for dust, scratches, or damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an Epson EB-U04 projector from visible labels in all photos. While the WUXGA resolution claim is unverifiable remotely, the model is confirmed.
